children: Castellum announced a $32.8 million modification to a NAVAIR PMA-290 order, raising GTMR’s contract ceiling to $136.2 million.
The $32.8M modification expands scope under GTMR’s SeaPort-NxG order supporting NAVAIR PMA-290 Special Missions.
The change increases the total contract ceiling to $136.2M, marking the largest prime contract win in Castellum’s history.
Approximately $1.1M of the modification is funded now; that funded portion is expected to be completed by March 2027.
Added scope covers technical and programmatic support across multiple ISRT programs (P-8A, MQ-4C Triton, Maritime Patrol, Special Missions Platforms, etc.).
